note: Calame et al. demonstrated that DHX9 pathogenic variants exhibit mislocalization to cytoplasm or nucleoli, while DHX30 variants are characterized by alterations in stress granule dynamics.

evidence.text: Whereas wild-type DHX9 is restricted to the nucleus, DHX9 NLS missense variants abnormally accumulate in the cytoplasm (confirmed in patient fibroblasts) and CMT2-associated missense variants cause aberrant nucleolar DHX9 accumulation.

source.title: Monoallelic variation in DHX9, the gene encoding the DExH-box helicase DHX9, underlies neurodevelopment disorders and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease
source.quote: Whereas wild-type DHX9 was restricted to the nucleus, NLS missense variants abnormally accumulated in the cytoplasm. Fibroblasts from an individual with an NLS variant also showed abnormal cytoplasmic DHX9 accumulation. CMT2-associated missense variants caused aberrant nucleolar DHX9 accumulation, a phenomenon previously associated with cellular stress.

evidence.text: Pathogenic variants in DHX30 are linked to neurodevelopmental disorders specifically through aberrant dynamics and involvement in stress granules.

source.title: The role of DEAD-and DExH-box RNA helicases in neurodevelopmental disorders
source.quote: of stress granules is an important feature of NDD associated pathogenic variants in DHX30
